newsitem.title: USA: Daisytek doubles size of Memphis hub.
newsitem.headline: Daisytek doubles size of Memphis hub.

text.p: Daisytek International Corp said Thursday it has extended its lease to expand its Memphis distribution hub.

The company said the size of its Memphis hub would increase from 176,000 square feet to 372,000 square feet through a four-year lease agreement. Earlier this year Daisytek completed a $2.5 million upgrade of the facility.
The company also announced that Michael Krasny has resigned from its board of directors and has been replaced by James Powell, senior vice president of sales and marketing.
